::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [4 November 1890]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

Many thanks, I cannot be quite sure about Luise but if she is not used within a year, she shall be returned

C M Yonge[^1]

---

[^1]: A postcard addressed to 'Mrs Lynch/ West End Hotel/ San Remo/ Italy' and postmarked Winchester 4 November 1890. [Mrs Lynch](people/person_2437.qmd) may be the E. M. Lynch who had previously contributed to *MP*.
